title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

title: Sales executive - shipyards & shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners
Department: Sales
Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M& O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.
The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M& O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Product & Solution Representation
Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards. Business Development
Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
Expand M& O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction. Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions. Sales Strategy & Reporting
Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M& O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.
Skills and Competencies B2 B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales. Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams. Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance. Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes. Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.
Experience Requirements 2 to 5 years of experience in B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors. Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers . Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects. title: Analista de validação de processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.
2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).
3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.
4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.
5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.
6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.
7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.
10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

· Experiência prévia em coordenação, supervisão ou liderança de equipes operacionais;

· Soft skills essenciais: senso de dono, proatividade, liderança, comunicação clara, pensamento crítico e adaptabilidade.
Desejáveis (diferenciais): · Pós-graduação em Gestão Educacional, Administração ou áreas afins;
· Visão estratégica aplicada à operação;
· Experiência com processos comerciais e ações de captação;
· Familiaridade com plataformas de EAD (AVA), sistemas acadêmicos e CRM.

title: Fullstack developer (node.js + react + aws)
description:
About You
You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and Type Script . Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and Type Script . Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or Graph QL APIs . Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB, S3, Cloud Front, and Cognito. Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments. Advanced experience with Dynamo DB , including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling. Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems. Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or similar Ia C tools . Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably Git Hub Actions). Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using Cloud Watch or similar tools. Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand. Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.
Experience mentoring junior engineers or acting as a technical reference is a strong plus.
You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and Type Script.
Develop and operate high-performance REST and Graph QL APIs.
Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
Model and optimize data access patterns in Dynamo DB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
Build and maintain frontend applications using React and Type Script, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.
Qualifications Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and Type Script . Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB. Experience building REST / Graph QL APIs . Experience using AWS CDK or Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Additional Information
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.
Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

· Receber, filtrar e qualificar leads ;
· Fazer primeiro contato com potenciais clientes;
· Atualizar e manter o CRM e controles internos com disciplina e qualidade;
· Apoiar nas rotinas administrativas do setor comercial (backoffice), garantindo organização e fluidez do processo;

· Organizar recepções e eventos comerciais , cuidando de detalhes operacionais e da experiência do convidado/cliente (preparação do ambiente, checklists, apoio logístico);
· Colaborar com a equipe na melhoria de processos , sugerindo ajustes práticos para aumentar produtividade e conversão.
Requisitos necessários:
· Ensino Superior Completo ou em andamento;
· Boa comunicação verbal e escrita (clareza, educação, objetividade);
· Perfil proativo , com iniciativa e independência;
· Conhecimento básico em CRM e pacote Office/Google (planilhas, e-mail, documentos);
· Disponibilidade para viagem;
· Organização e atenção aos detalhes ;

· Experiência prévia em áreas comerciais, pré-vendas/SDR, backoffice ou atendimento ao cliente;
· Noções de qualificação de leads e funil de vendas (MQL/SQL, etapas, follow-up);
· Interesse por tecnologia e vontade de aprender sobre soluções embarcadas (dashcams, MDVR, rastreadores, telemetria);
· Experiência com recepção de clientes e apoio na organização de eventos corporativos.
Oferecemos:
· Modelo: Híbrido — Barra da Tijuca (RJ)
· Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, 08h30 às 17h30
· Salário: R$ 2.859,93
· Vale-refeição: R$ 25,00 por dia
· Plano de saúde e dental Bradesco (após período de experiência)
· Vale-transporte
· Ambiente dinâmico, com processos em evolução , espaço para ideias e oportunidade real de crescimento para quem entrega e quer aprender.
Como é ter sucesso nessa vaga (o que valorizamos de verdade):
· Agilidade com qualidade (responder rápido, registrar tudo e não deixar ponta solta)
· Comunicação humana e profissional
· Proatividade: identificar gargalos, antecipar demandas e “puxar responsabilidade”
· Vontade de aprender e evoluir constantemente
Venha fazer parte do nosso time e ajudar a construir um comercial forte, organizado e com atendimento de excelência!

title: Fpga engineer (brazil) | engenheiro(a) de fpga (brasil)
description:
The Opportunity
Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.Your Role
Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.Who you are
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2 C, UART, and CAN;
Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
Experience with hardware debug and tests;
Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
Fluency in English, both oral and written.Working Conditions
Competitive Compensation packages
Energizing and supportive work environment
Remote work

_______________________________________________________________OportunidadeOs Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.Função
Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.Quem é você
Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2 C, UART e CAN;
Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head Of Brand, Marketing And Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women’s World Cup™ by 2x.

Join to apply for the Analista de Contratos Sênior role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.

  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

A Accenture é uma empresa global líder em serviços profissionais que ajuda as principais organizações do mundo, governos e outras companhias a construir seu núcleo digital, otimizar suas operações, acelerar o crescimento da receita e aprimorar os serviços aos cidadãos, criando valor tangível em velocidade e escala. Somos uma empresa liderada por talentos e inovação, com aproximadamente 801 mil pessoas atendendo clientes em mais de 120 países. A tecnologia está no centro da mudança hoje, e somos um dos líderes globais em ajudar a impulsionar essa mudança, com fortes relacionamentos de ecossistema. Combinamos nossa força em tecnologia e liderança em nuvem, dados e IA com experiência incomparável no setor, expertise funcional e capacidade de entrega global. Nossa ampla gama de serviços, soluções e ativos em Estratégia e Consultoria, Tecnologia, Operações, Industry X e Song, juntamente com nossa cultura de sucesso compartilhado e comprometimento em criar valor 360°, nos permitem ajudar nossos clientes a reinventar e construir relacionamentos confiáveis e duradouros. Medimos nosso sucesso pelo valor 360° que criamos para nossos clientes, uns aos outros, nossos acionistas, parceiros e comunidades. Visite-nos em accenture.Com.

Buscamos um profissional com experiência em consultoria e indústria para atuar em projetos de grande impacto nas maiores empresas do Brasil e do mundo. O candidato ideal deve ter forte habilidade para analisar dados e interpretar informações complexas, saber extrair insights relevantes e conectar pontos de diferentes áreas, alto poder de síntese, excelente capacidade de adaptação e excelente comunicação para interagir com equipes multiculturais e clientes.

O que você vai fazer no seu dia a dia:

  • Liderar uma frente de trabalho com apresentação de resultados de forma executiva;
  • Estruturar análises baseadas nos dados e no entendimento do contexto do cliente;
  • Atuar em projetos de consultoria de negócio e transformação digital nas indústrias, realizando avaliações de maturidade e diagnósticos, construindo estratégias e Roadmaps, e realizando acompanhamento e gestão de projetos.
  • Desenhar processos de negócio (ex.. Desenho de fluxos, detalhamento de atividades, definição de RACI, construção de árvores de valor e indicadores), e aplicar metodologias de negócio (ex. Design thinking ) e gestão (ex. PMBOK, SCRUM)
  • Criar recomendações de soluções baseadas em conhecimento de Industria e Gestão de ativos (Preferencialmente conhecimento em processos como Estratégia, Planejamento, controle e programação de manutenção e Confiabilidade de ativos)
  • Reportar evoluções aos executivos do projeto;
  • Interagir com nível gerencial e operacional do cliente;
  • Suportar equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de desenho e implementação de tecnologias.
  • Estruturar business cases, com domínio em análise quantitativa e qualitativa na solução de problemas e orientação para entrega de valor

Alem disso, é necessário conhecimento:

  • Possuir conhecimentos em indústrias.
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de ativos.
  • Experiência em Consultoria é imprescindível;
  • Conhecimento avançado em inglês;

  • Possuir conhecimentos em algum desses setores: Logística, Mineração, Oleo e Gas
  • Idioma Espanhol.

O que a Accenture oferece:

Na Accenture, investimos no desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais como nenhuma outra organização:

  • Profissionais com oportunidades iguais para se desenvolver. Incentivamos a progressão de carreira por mérito, tendo como base o nosso principal valor: Respeito ao Indivíduo.

  • Abraçamos a diversidade e vivemos sem distinção de gênero, cor, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, posição social ou deficiências.

  • Investimos em treinamentos com temas alinhados ao mercado e tendências. Atuamos com as melhores pessoas que, desde o primeiro momento, trazem valor para os clientes.

Benefícios:

Buscamos perfis que estejam alinhados aos valores da empresa, entusiastas em trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, com excelência na entrega e inovação presentes em seu dia a dia.

Valorizamos competências independentemente de raça, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, credo, deficiência e convicção política. A diversidade das nossas pessoas é o que nos permite cumprir a promessa da tecnologia e da criatividade humana.

title: Head Of Media Operations & Services
description:
Join to apply for the Head of Media Operations & Services role at FIFA Women’s World Cup™

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Responsible for detailed planning and implementation of media facilities & services in the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 stadiums based on the FIFA HQ MEO strategy.
  • Manage and contribute to the Senior Media operations manager and Senior Media services work.
  • Define functional area’s Entity budget requirements and finalise budget reviews.
  • Manage, contribute, supervise the implementation of the scope and delivery of media‑dedicated services, including technology, accommodation, accreditation, catering and transport.
  • Contribute and supervise the implementation of the media‑dedicated spaces and flows, in all competition and non‑competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Liaise with the Host Cities to define media‑dedicated areas and services.
  • Engage with local and international media to support the requirements needs and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Define and implement a rate card solution for International News Agencies and other key media outlets in coordination with technology.
  • Organise relevant workshops and meetings (media workshops, agency visits etc.).
  • Hire and deploy event‑time staff – in coordination with FIFA Zurich HQ – Venue Media Managers & Venue Media Coordinators – in the various stadiums, managing all logistics and administrative tasks.
  • Event‑time, manage and coordinate the venue media staff & services for all matches across the various venues.
  • Define and contribute to the information tools and supports (FIFA Media app content, media guide) for media in general, potentially other target groups on operations and services.
  • Support the FIFA Media Department & Local Entity with media operations & services during events.
  • Contribute to the promotion of the tournament supporting FIFA and Local Entity departments involved.
  • Manage planning, preparations and fulfilment of inspections to the FWWC 2027 stadiums and various other locations where media will be working.
  • Participate in the development and management of trainings, workshops and production of information for media‑related workforce and volunteers.
  • Organises media conferences, media days and other media activities.
  • Oversee and deliver a complete and detailed reporting of media operations and services progress to the FIFA Zurich responsible.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent.
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management.
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media operations (broadcast is a plus).
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football.
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Seniority Level

Mid‑Senior level

Contract

title: Enfermeiro (Gastroenterologia) - Hospital Cardosofontes
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores
  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem

Pós-graduação Completa na área de Centro cirúrgico / cme

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Prestar assistência de enfermagem a pacientes com doenças do trato gastrointestinal, atuando no preparo, acompanhamento e recuperação em exames e procedimentos gastroenterológicos, garantindo cuidado seguro, humanizado e conforme protocolos institucionais.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.

  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.

  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property. This includes, but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.

  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

title: Ajudante Prático | Região Metropolitana

JOB DESCRIPTION Serviços de apoio técnico e suporte especializado em atividades laboratoriais para pesquisa aplicada à exploração, produção e refino de petróleo. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Registro e controle de custódia de amostras laboratoriais e suas subamostras;
Suportar a demanda de ensaios de química analítica: realizar protocolo de implantação/validação/desenvolvimento/processamento e realização de método analítico na área de química por: espectroscopia de absorção e emissão no ultravioleta, visível e por espectroscopia vibracional (infravermelho e Raman);
Emitir laudos de análise, especificar tecnicamente e encaminhar solicitações de compras de equipamentos e insumos em atendimento às exigências da legislação vigente e de forma a garantir a confiabilidade analítica do laboratório;

Construção, execuçãoe manutenção de ferramentas de controle e garantia da qualidade de resultados analíticos (cartas de controle, curvas de calibração, controle de padrões certificados etc.), bem como quaisquer ações necessárias para viabilizar a gestão da qualidade;
Preparo de amostras (pesagem, centrifugação, precipitação, filtração, extração com solventes, extração em fase sólida e quaisquer outras operações unitárias necessárias para adequação da amostra original ao método analítico instrumental que suportará o atendimento solicitado, não exclusivo a métodos cromatográficos);
Fracionamento e análise de amostras;
Aferição das vidrarias de precisão, no ato do recebimento ou sob demanda específica;
Alimentação debases de dados por uso de softwares de aplicação à laboratórios de análises químicas;
Manutenção básica operacional dos equipamentos, configuração básica de hardware e software;
Solicitar e acompanhar manutenção das instalações, equipamentos e fornecimento de consumíveis;
Gestão das amostras no laboratório, incluindo recebimento, aceitação e armazenamento adequado das amostras, cadastro de amostras, solicitação de ensaios, emissão de resultados, devolução de amostras já concluídas no sistema de gerenciamento de informações de laboratório (LIMS) vigente;
Gestão e controle deestoque e orçamentação de insumos (reagentes, padrões etc.), peças e equipamentos laboratoriais;
Coordenação, execução, atualização e confecção de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrões pertinentes às rotinas laboratoriais;
Coordenação e execução de descartes de resíduos laboratoriais;
Zelar, executar e garantir o cumprimento das normas e requisitos de segurança do laboratório e liberação de serviços no local;
Coordenação detreinamentos necessários para capacitação de técnicos na execução das análises e metodologias analíticas. Realizar visitas técnicas externas para acompanhamento e execução de serviços ou incorporação de tecnologias;
Otimização dosrecursos e infraestrutura laboratoriais para produção analítica;
Emissão de relatórios e/ou laudos (certificados) de análise em português e/ou Inglês;
Demais atividades à execução dos serviços de laboratório. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Formação: Graduação Completa em Química. Experiência: Vivência mínima de 6 anos em análises de espectrometria ótica IV/UV, Fluorescência e RAMAN. Conhecimentos Obrigatórios: Conhecimento em Espectroscopia de absorção e emissão no Ultravioleta-Visível e por espectroscopia vibracional (infravermelho e Raman);
Domínio do Pacote Office;
Nível intermediário (leitura e escrita) da Língua Inglesa. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION BEM-VINDO(A) AO MUNDO INFOTEC! Nós somos uma empresa especializada em Terceirização de Serviços e Processos, atuamos há 35 anos no mercado de outsourcing de serviços, processos e pessoas. Nossos serviços permitem que os clientes mantenham foco nas principais estratégias de negócio enquanto promovemos eficiência operacional, por meio da otimização de processos e redução de custos, com o uso de recursos tecnológicos, baixo absenteísmo, menor risco trabalhista, cuidados ambientais e muito mais. Nesse momento de expansão e desenvolvimento da Infotec, queremos te convidar a fazer parte desse grande time. Vamos juntos? :)

title: React Senior Developer | Latam | 100% Remote
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Job Duties: You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process. Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements. Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing). Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations. Nice to have: Postgraduate or Master’s degree. Spanish proficiency. IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles. Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization. Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation .

description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia role at ARAMCO .

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join the Chemicals & Retail Legal Practice of the Downstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Practice provides legal support to many downstream entities, primarily from a shareholder and governance perspective, with a focus on general corporate and commercial contracts.

As Counsel, your primary role is to provide legal advice to Saudi Aramco and its subsidiaries, particularly in the area of commercial agreements for the supply and offtake of Saudi Aramco’s wide array of products, including long‑term crude and product sales/placements, crude importation, long‑term refined product/chemical offtakes, processing/netting agreements, tolling arrangements and international hydrocarbon trading.

  • Advise on internal policies, review and resolve claims, and provide training to company personnel on a variety of legal matters.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Law degree minimum; Master or Juris degree preferred.

  • A minimum of 7 years progressive experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. A mix of private practice and in‑house experience would be preferred.

title: Chief Audit Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Audit Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Howard University is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution’s senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Audit Execution

  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk‑based internal audit plan aligned with the university’s strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow‑up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions

Risk Management & Advisory Services

  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management

Investigations & Special Projects

  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership

Independence & Professional Standards

  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised

Team Leadership & External Coordination

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Familiarity with Python

  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).
